description: Reviews API: List Google Play reviews. Reviews of a Google Play app as `Review` objects, newest or most relevant first, with the developer's reply when there is one. `meta.entity` is the app. With several star ratings, the reviews of each come one after the other. A page that returns nothing only because of the filters, with `has_more` true, is free. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 50, one page of the source)

name: reviews_googleplay_app_reviews
title: List Google Play reviews
